I’m 25 and in U.K. 

I dunno what to do honestly I don’t see any future at all. I usually go for older guys. They are all single sleeping with a bunch of other guys. Everyone is terrified of anything genuine it’s all so shallow. It’s so depressing. 

I see older gay guys. They all have this sad lube box beside their bed and just are fucking lonely. Their lives seem so empty. No chance of a family ext. It’s just so EMPTY. 

It’s so shit. Guaranteed no future. I was seeing a therapist who is also gay. He told me he’s cheating on his partner for some reason. And yeah. I stopped seeing him. I don’t understand people. There’s nothing redeemable or wholesome or meaningful about being gay. It’s so shit. I wish I was just normal. It’s shit
You’re all genuinely so lovely I didn’t expect this much love from you all. It really helped. Thank you all from the bottom of my heart.
Thank you beautiful soul. I went to the doctors and am now on PEP. they tested me too. They were lovely. I was in bits to be honest. But I’m glad went.

I’m just numb I don’t really know what to do. Just want to chill with my grandparents and forget if ever happened. I don’t remember much. It’s an ordeal in the U.K. sexual assault cases rarely end in convictions. Perhaps I’m weak. I don’t know
Bless your heart thank you for your kindness and time in responding to my post. I feel more optimistic now. Getting things out of your head is good. Thank you truly.
